recovery_method: The explicit /pdf/<id>v1 URLs returned an internal web retrieval error, but official /pdf/<id> URLs opened. Each official arXiv abstract version history lists v1 as the only version, so the unversioned PDF is the same cutoff version for this targeted source screen.

rows.source_locator: PDF p. 1 abstract/field evaluation; p. 9 threats to validity; p. 10 section VIII Conclusion and Future Work
rows.source_basis: The CAM test-alarm cause classifier was already evaluated on two industrial datasets and deployed at one partner; these completed results are not open outcomes. The paper explicitly proposes adding more software artifacts and verifying CAM on more projects. A matched log-only versus augmented-artifact, out-of-project comparison was not reported in the inspected sections.
rows.candidate_question: Across held-out industrial software projects, does adding software artifacts to the CAM log-based test-alarm classifier improve independently verified cause-classification accuracy over log-only CAM at matched training budget?
rows.comparison_and_metric: same classifier family with versus without extra software artifacts, trained without test-project leakage; held-out project-level multiclass cause accuracy and cost
rows.falsification_gate: No reproducible held-out project-level accuracy gain at comparable labeling/training budget, or a gain confined to already-seen projects, fails the proposed generalization and artifact-value claim.

rows.source_basis: The paper proves results for bipartite and staged-bipartite compatibility graphs, then explicitly asks about computational complexity on bounded-degree tree compatibility graphs, stating no complexity result in its setting. The inspected source does not solve that case.
rows.candidate_question: For the paper's stretched coupled-task makespan problem, what is the exact computational complexity when the compatibility graph is a tree of bounded maximum degree?
rows.comparison_and_metric: formal P versus NP-hardness/parameterized classification under the same task timing and tree-degree definitions
rows.falsification_gate: A correct polynomial-time algorithm or hardness proof for the bounded-degree tree setting settles a corresponding branch; a theorem for a different compatibility graph or task model does not.

limitation: Targeted sections, not exhaustive page-by-page annotation. The source work was already published in a 2016 journal according to arXiv metadata, so originality of later formulations is not inferred.
